title: External Review of Final Internal Denials in the Member Appeals Program
content:
External review is available under the Member Appeals Program only where the member's Northbridge Appeals package makes it available. It is a review of a final internal denial by a reviewer outside the internal appeal process.

## Provisions

**1. Who may request it.** When the package makes external review available, a member may request it if the member's internal appeals are exhausted, or are deemed exhausted where the package provides deemed exhaustion. The request goes through the package's external review route, and the denial must fall within the package's external review scope.

**2. Exhaustion.** An external review may be requested only after the internal appeals on the same denied record are exhausted. Whether they are exhausted is read from the appeal records of that denied record.

**3. Time limit.** External review must be requested no later than the package's external review filing period after the final internal decision. The period is in months, and its expiry falls on the same day of the month that many months later. When that day does not exist in the month, the expiry falls on the last day of that month. A request made on the expiry day itself is in time.

**4. Decision periods.** A standard external review is decided within the package's standard external period, counted in days from the reviewer's receipt. An expedited external review is decided within the package's expedited period, in hours. When the package allows it, an urgent case may go to expedited external review while the urgent internal appeal is still pending.

**5. Fee and effect.** The member pays the package's external review fee. The fee is refunded if the denial is overturned. When the package so provides, an overturn binds the plan.

## Expiry of the time limit (hypothetical dates, filing period of 4 months)

| Date of the final internal decision | Expiry | Request on the expiry day | Request the next day |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30 June | 30 October | In time | Late |
| 31 October | Last day of February (there is no 31 February) | In time | Late |
| 15 January | 15 May | In time | Late |

A package that does not make external review available shows a filing period of 0.

## Points of judgement

- The time limit runs from the final internal decision. It does not run from the original denial notice.
- Exhaustion is judged for the same denied record. Appeals concluded on other denied records of the member do not count.
